recipe.title: Lamb, feta and pasta salad
recipe.prep: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.

i.n: lamb fillets or shortloins, trimmed of all silver membrane

method.s: Cook the pasta according to packet directions.
Meanwhile, heat a large frypan with the first measure of oil, and pan fry the lamb for about 3 minutes each side until just cooked, but still pink.
Reserve and rest the lamb, covered, for 5 minutes.
Toss all other ingredients except seasoning in a large bowl. Drain and add the pasta. Slice the lamb and add, along with any juices that have accumulated.
Season to taste and serve immediately, or cover and store in the fridge until required.
